fact_text: Investors read a budget on two questions: does the macro outlook keep equities the best asset class in Pakistan, and do policy changes alter the outlook for the specific companies already held.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: If oil stays high, the analyst expects inflation to ease and policy rates not to rise sharply, which he calls supportive for equities.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The current account is highly sensitive to oil prices: high oil keeps the deficit in the low single digits of GDP, while a fall in oil could turn it into a surplus.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The IMF programme's central fiscal condition is a primary surplus target, meaning government revenue exceeds spending before interest payments; the analyst puts the Budget 2026 target at about 2 percent of GDP.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects new revenue from services and agriculture, through provincial-level taxes rather than heavy new federal taxes, with about PKR 500 bn targeted from these sources.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A regional conflict hit tax collection, which the analyst says reduces room for the corporate tax cuts that had been planned before the conflict.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Income tax and super tax together absorb almost half of a Pakistani company's profit, which makes the corporate tax rate the main budget lever for listed-company earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The corporate income tax is 29 percent plus a 10 percent super tax; a proposal would cut income tax by 1 point a year to 25 percent and phase the super tax down to zero.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects a smaller cut in this budget, about 1 point off income tax and about 2 points off super tax, and considers abolishing the fixed-tax regime less likely.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Worked example: on PKR 100 of pre-tax profit a 39 percent tax leaves 61; a 3-point cut lifts after-tax profit to about 64, a rise of roughly 4 to 5 percent that the analyst says flows into fair value.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A tax cut lifts stock prices through two channels: next-year profits rise immediately, and expectations of further cuts raise fair values again, by roughly 5 to 7 percent in total.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Proposals include zero capital gains tax on shares held three years and removal of withholding tax on dividends between group companies, such as Engro Holdings receiving dividends from Engro Fertilizer; the analyst rates these less likely than rate cuts.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Transmission rule: when duties and sales tax on a product fall, its price falls, demand rises, and the seller can earn higher total profit on a larger volume despite the lower price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's IT export regime taxes only a deemed 25 percent of export proceeds under income tax; the scheme is expiring and the analyst expects an extension given government export targets.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Salaried IT staff pay roughly 25 to 30 percent tax while freelancers exporting pay far less, which penalises large domestic IT firms; the analyst says a fix for salaries is hard to design.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Exporters moved from a fixed 1 percent tax to the normal 39 percent regime, with the minimum tax raised from 1 to 2 percent; the analyst expects the minimum to return to 1 percent and possibly the super tax on exporters to go.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Southern cement makers export heavily, so they would gain if the exporter rate falls from the 39 percent normal regime to about 29 percent by dropping the super tax.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pharma companies are shifting focus toward exports, so a lower exporter tax gives the sector a modest boost in the analyst's view.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Meat exporters are named by the analyst as likely beneficiaries of any cut in the exporter tax rate.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The petroleum levy on petrol and diesel averages about PKR 80 per litre at present.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The budget raises the petroleum levy collection target about 20 percent above the current year, which the analyst thinks is hard to meet unless oil falls or fuel volumes hold up.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Transmission rule: higher pump prices cut fuel volumes, so a levy target that grows faster than volumes forces a higher per-litre levy, which the analyst says could reach PKR 90 to 100 per litre.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A climate finance levy on petrol and diesel was PKR 2.50 per litre and is set to rise to PKR 5 per litre under the climate finance facility signed with the IMF.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Combining the levies, the analyst expects petrol and diesel taxes to rise by about PKR 10 to 15 per litre on average in the budget year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Government gas receivables of roughly PKR 500 to 600 bn owed to OGDC and PPL are a cash-release catalyst; payment would lift cash and share prices, though the analyst says the plan is not directly tied to the budget.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan Petroleum is among the gas producers owed large government receivables under the gas circular debt arrangement; collection would release cash to the company.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A joint OGDC and PPL discovery is expected to produce about 20,000 barrels of oil in roughly two years, which the analyst treats as a future earnings driver.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Before buying an oil stock after an oil-price rally, check whether the windfall profits are already in the share price, since the rally may already be priced in if the conflict ends.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan Refinery is undertaking a deep-conversion upgrade that the analyst describes as the sector's largest, and refinery-policy approval would bring that work forward.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Refinery upgrades let Pakistan turn imported crude into local diesel and petrol instead of importing refined products, which cuts the import bill.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Imported refinery machinery attracts 18 percent sales tax, which lifts a roughly USD 6 bn upgrade programme to over USD 7 bn; refiners want that tax exempted to restart upgrades.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: If the sales tax exemption is approved, the analyst expects refiners to move from negative to positive sector sentiment and to begin upgrades.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst calls the refinery with the largest cash balance and most advanced upgrade the safest way to invest in the refining theme if the policy is approved.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: After an oil shock, the IMF and other lenders tend to grant emerging markets more flexibility, as Pakistan saw with relaxations and extra loans during COVID.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues that PSX investing during past oil shocks paid off over the following years, while conceding that past performance guarantees nothing.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A housing and property policy package benefits construction-linked stocks, because cement, glass and steel demand rises with construction activity.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Apna Ghar scheme offers 20-year bank financing for homes costing under PKR 1 crore, with instalments designed to be close to the rent the buyer would otherwise pay.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects buying and selling taxes on property to be cut in this budget, which would support property transactions.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Proposals include abolishing the fixed 1 percent value-based CVT on overseas-held investments and the Islamabad CVT, which would ease the holding of savings in Pakistan property.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The government is trying to channel overseas Pakistanis' savings into domestic property and stocks, which would lift remittances and dollar inflows to the external account.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Stocks move before development: equities price construction-linked profits early, while plots and property projects re-rate about 6 months to 2 years after the news.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cement is so low-value per ton that imported cement cannot cover freight from port to inland cities such as Lahore, so trade-duty changes barely affect cement makers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst prefers northern cement makers with low bank debt, so a coal-price spike or slow recovery does not put pressure on their finances.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Federal development spending (PSDP) goes mostly to steel and cement, but the analyst says provincial development budgets matter more because provinces usually spend their full allocations.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Steel is protected by high import duties; cutting them would force makers to lower prices, so volumes may hold while profits fall, which the analyst sees as negative.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Steel imported through the FATA and PATA areas paid a concessional 10 percent sales tax; the rate rises by 2 points a year over four years back to the normal 18 percent.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Glass carries high duties, but freight costs protect northern glass makers; the analyst puts about half of the market under this natural protection.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Banks lend the most to the government, so irresponsible fiscal behaviour lowers the chance of repayment and pressures bank earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: For banks the budget matters little; the tax rate and macro stability are the main items, and a lower corporate tax rate helps them somewhat.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Proposals include cutting rates on each salary slab and removing the 10 percent surcharge on individual incomes above PKR 1 crore a year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Transmission rule: lower personal tax raises disposable income, which lifts spending on homes, cement and everyday consumer goods (FMCG).
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Stronger FX reserves cut the risk that the government curbs car imports to protect reserves, which the analyst sees as positive for the auto sector.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The government appears keen to cut duties and sales tax on PHEVs, EVs and battery cars to reduce oil imports, which the analyst expects in this budget.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Imported used cars often arrive several years old with weak after-sales service, and an older imported car still burns imported petrol.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Local parts makers push for localisation and duty protection, while new Chinese-brand entrants import parts from China rather than buy locally.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Japanese incumbents lobby for hybrids alongside PHEVs, arguing they lag Chinese makers in EV technology and need the same tax relief.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A plug-in hybrid charged daily burns far less petrol than a standard hybrid, which still uses roughly 60 to 70 percent of the petrol of a normal engine car.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects the Number One Car framework, which sets duty and tax by price band, to favour Chinese-brand assemblers such as Sazgar and Nishat-linked distributors of the Jaco brand.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Indus Motor could bring in Toyota plug-in hybrids if duty and sales tax on PHEVs fall, the analyst suggests.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The IMF is discussing an extra 5 percent federal excise duty on urea and other fertilisers, which would raise bag prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Urea makers have pricing power and pass cost increases through to farmers, so the analyst watches farm economics more than the budget for this sector.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Tractor and fertilizer sales rise when farm incomes improve, because farmers then see returns from spending on extra inputs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Fatima Fertilizer and FFC have lower gas costs than Engro Fertilizer, which lets them sell urea bags at a lower price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When demand is uncertain, low-cost producers sell out first, so the analyst prefers low-cost fertilizer makers in that environment.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Reversal of price deregulation for non-essential medicines is unlikely, in the analyst's view.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Raw-material import duties for pharma keep falling under the IMF tariff programme, and items still above zero are likely to reach zero, a mild boost to the sector.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Annual power tariff increases have been agreed to take effect in January rather than July, because summer bills already rise, which changes the timing of chemical makers' power costs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Chemical makers are heavy electricity users, so power tariff changes feed directly into their cost base.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Products that are hard to import, such as industrial oxygen and caustic soda, are less exposed to duty cuts because shipping them is costly.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lotte Chemical sells at import-parity prices, so when duties on finished chemicals fall its selling prices fall too and margins are squeezed.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Engro Polymer sells at import-parity prices, so lower duties on polymers force its prices down, which the analyst treats as a margin risk.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst names Ittehad Chemicals as a caustic soda play, benefiting from the import difficulty that protects caustic soda makers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst names Sitara Chemicals as a chemical investment within the same caustic soda protection thesis.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst names Ghani Chemical as an industrial oxygen play, since oxygen is hard to import and therefore protected.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst names Pak Oxygen as another industrial oxygen play, for the same reason that imports of oxygen are hard.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Don't Lose Money: 2026 Budget Moves for Every Investor' (YouTube transcript, undated)
